QUICKFIT® | YKK DIGITAL SHOWROOM
QUICKFIT®

Product code：
Z15-1

Contact us about this product
Add to My List

The QUICKFIT® hook fastener is an effective and efficient seat tie down system for automotive seats.
Its design accommodates curve lines and also provides long and joint-less seam lines.
Its excellent self-alignment capability helps shorten the time required to install. The loop is able to be used from the outside of the seat cover. It is recommended to be used with the QUICKLOOP® loop fastener.
The QUICKFIT® hook fastener has a magnetic material that allows the operator to easily and quickly install it in the die set groove. The "self- aligning" feature of the QUICKFIT® hook fastener increases work speed and improves productivity. Self-aligning is a productivity-enhancing feature, and the QUICKFIT® hook fastener can be easily attached to the die set.

Applications
Performance
Item Variations

Straight & flexible types

Notice

YKK recommends using a combination of QUICKFIT® hooks and QUICKLOOP® loops to increase productivity.

methodology.capture: Fresh Playwright Chromium context per URL/viewport; load + 10 seconds; full-page PNG, deviceScaleFactor 1, viewport sizing only, no mobile UA emulation. mainContentVisible requires visible main and visible item title.
methodology.scores: Three fresh Chromium launches per page/device, Lighthouse default mobile and desktop preset; simulated throttling. Category medians on 0–100 scale; no score thresholds or product verdict.
methodology.auditRanking: Top three per page/device ranked by median audit score ascending (nonfailing runs count as 1), then failure frequency descending, then audit ID. Not an impact ranking.
methodology.screenshots: Successful page PNGs are in gitignored test-results/JOB-ZZ-IDLE-14; not committed. No rendered page failed, so no PNGs committed. Japanese 404 recorded only, per job.
methodology.limitations: Figma Q29 unavailable; no visual comparison. Build SHA not independently verified. Video playback not exercised. Related-card media areas are blank; no verdict.
